rates.merchants: Hyatt hotels and resorts, World of Hyatt Experiences
rates.note: See hyatt.com/chase-earn-terms for purchases that do not qualify.

rates.merchants: Top 3 of 8 categories each quarter, set by spend

benefits.name: Hyatt credit
benefits.notes: $50 statement credit on each of up to two qualifying Hyatt purchases per cardmember year.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit loaded into your Instacart+ account each month; requires an active Instacart+ membership (3 months complimentary, then paid) and an order paid with the card. Unused credit expires at month end.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter while enrolled in DashPass via the card (12 months complimentary, then paid). Offer runs through 12/31/2027 (activate DashPass by then).

benefits.name: Discoverist status
benefits.notes: World of Hyatt Discoverist status for the authorizing officer while the account is open, plus 5 Discoverist Upgrade Awards to gift status to 5 employees. Also 5 tier-qualifying night credits for every $10,000 in purchases each calendar year.

benefits.name: 10% points redemption bonus
benefits.notes: After $50,000 in purchases in a calendar year (you and employees combined), get 10% of redeemed points back for the rest of that year, on up to 200,000 points redeemed.

benefits.name: Hyatt Leverage membership
benefits.notes: Complimentary Hyatt Leverage membership for the authorizing officer (up to 15% off standard room rates at participating Hyatt hotels); enroll at hyatt.com/hl-chase.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated with the card by 12/31/2027, then auto-renews at the paid rate until cancelled. Activation window 2/1/2025-12/31/2027.
